# Native error codes

A platform's own error code, read as the IoError every operation here reports.

<h2 id="native-kind"><code>NativeKind</code></h2>

```rux
pub func NativeKind(raw: int32) -> IoErrorKind
```

The meaning of a platform error code on the platform this program was compiled for.
Codes with no portable meaning translate to `Other`; the caller still has the raw code beside it.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FileSystem/Src/Translate.rux#L17)

**Parameters**

| Name  | Type    | Description                             |
| ----- | ------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `raw` | `int32` | the platform's own error number or code |

**Returns**: the kind this package gives that platform code

<h2 id="translate-native"><code>TranslateNative</code></h2>

```rux
pub func TranslateNative(raw: int32) -> IoError
```

A platform error code as the structured error everything here reports.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/FileSystem/Src/Translate.rux#L76)

**Parameters**

| Name  | Type    | Description                             |
| ----- | ------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `raw` | `int32` | the platform's own error number or code |

**Returns**: the error this package gives that platform code, keeping the raw value
